tod_steps: Ask the IT Security Officer how the password parameters are configured in SAP S/4HANA and how they are compared to the security standard after upgrades.
Obtain the security standard and confirm it specifies 12 characters, complexity, 90-day expiry and lock after 5 attempts.
Inspect the current SAP parameter settings or system parameter extract against the standard.
Inspect the ITGC configuration baseline for the stored extract and the post-upgrade comparison.
Optionally observe a logon attempt to confirm enforcement.

attributes.attribute: Password parameters configured per the security standard
attributes.procedure: Inspect the live SAP parameter settings for minimum length, complexity, expiry and lockout, and compare each to the stated value.
attributes.evidence: System parameter extract; security standard

span.text: minimum 12 characters, complexity rules, 90-day expiry and account lock after 5 failed attempts

attributes.attribute: SAP enforces parameters at logon
attributes.procedure: Confirm the parameters are active system settings applied at logon, for example by a test logon or inspecting the active profile.
attributes.evidence: SAP active parameter display; test logon result

span.text: At every logon, SAP S/4HANA enforces the password parameters

attributes.attribute: Parameter extract stored in the ITGC baseline
attributes.procedure: Confirm a current extract exists in the baseline and agrees to the live settings.
attributes.evidence: ITGC configuration baseline extract

span.text: a system parameter extract stored in the ITGC configuration baseline

attributes.attribute: Settings compared to the standard after each upgrade
attributes.procedure: For each upgrade in the period, inspect the comparison performed by the IT Security Officer, its date and its sign-off, and confirm any differences were resolved.
attributes.evidence: Post-upgrade comparison record; upgrade list

span.text: which the IT Security Officer compares to the security standard after every SAP upgrade

scripts.exception_definition: A parameter that deviates from the stated requirement, not enforced at logon, no extract in the baseline, or no comparison to the standard after an SAP upgrade.
